title.en: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND AND CEDULA TAXES IN THE PROVINCE OF ORIENTAL NEGROS FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR UNTIL AUGUST THIRTY-FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR.
title.orig: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND AND CEDULA TAXES IN THE PROVINCE OF ORIENTAL NEGROS FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR UNTIL AUGUST THIRTY-FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR.
title.vi: Đạo luật gia hạn thời hạn nộp thuế đất và thuế cedula tại Đông Negros đến ngày 31/8/1904

title.id: Undang-Undang perpanjangan batas pembayaran pajak tanah dan pajak cedula di Oriental Negros untuk tahun 1904 hingga 31 Agustus 1904
title.ms: Akta melanjutkan tempoh pembayaran cukai tanah dan cukai cedula di Oriental Negros bagi tahun 1904 hingga 31 Ogos 1904

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_01168_1904_html.txt

text.en:
The period for the payment, without penalty, of the hind tax and cedula tax for the year nineteen
hundred and four in the Province of Oriental Negros is hereby extended to August thirty-First, nineteen
hundred and four.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 31, 1904.
